steps.prompt: What are you trying to do?

options.label: Fill a role
options.hint: The stage question below narrows it; "not sure" is allowed.

options.label: Hand a role over or wind a contract down
Plan headcount for a bid or an option year
Candidates pass but decline the offer

steps.prompt: Where is the opening, if you know?

options.label: Needs a security clearance or sponsorship
The customer approves or rejects the person by name
The skill is rare or the market is mostly passive
Market pay sits above what the contract rate can carry
A junior or developmental hire could fill it
The opening is tentative (proposal, option year, unfunded)
Cash or the hiring budget is tight
The team is carrying the vacancy and is overloaded
Onsite on a fixed schedule set by the customer

steps.note: All 51 records in states.yaml are selectable; the default is Alabama.

sections.title: Situation
sections.fills_from: the Start answers (goal, pattern, stage, conditions, state), as a sentence

sections.title: What we confirmed
sections.fills_from: constraints the user keeps from "Check these first" (name + how-to-tell line + sources)

sections.title: Actions
sections.fills_from: levers added with "Add to plan": plain name, the what_it_does_not_do line, sources; fields owner, by (date), measure left as placeholders

sections.title: Rules to check
sections.fills_from: gates and state overlays added from Plan or Rules: name, governing_text, as_of, primary_pending flag where set

sections.title: Numbers
sections.fills_from: indicators added from Plan or Numbers: value, counterpart value, reference_period, publisher, series

sections.title: Sources
sections.fills_from: every reference cited by anything above, in pack numbering with the citation line; filled automatically and not editable

carries: a link back to the page
quote_block.rule: a quote is never stored without its provenance; exports keep it as a footnote or trailing line
